patch.value: Bring pm-graph to real 100% line/branch/function coverage and raise the gate to 100

The coverage gate currently sits at lines 81 / branches 77 / functions 88. Drive every uncovered line and branch through real behavioural tests (harness commands, exported functions, local Neo4j error paths), remove genuinely dead code, and raise coverageGate.thresholds to 100/100/100.
Every source file reports 100.00 line/branch/function coverage; coverageGate.thresholds in package.json set to 100/100/100; npm run release:check exits 0; no gate weakened

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Baseline coverage: lines 85.49% / branches 80.17% / functions 90.43%. Source file src/index.ts: lines 84.22% / branches 78.54% / functions 89.66%. Scripts already at 100%. Uncovered lines concentrated in: Neo4j internal functions (toPlain/toNumber/neo4jFriendlyError/loadNeo4j), command help texts and error paths in activate(), graph analysis branches, and utility function edge cases.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Coverage milestone: added behavioral tests in test/coverage-gaps.test.ts and test/neo4j-install-fallback.test.ts with real SDK harness workspaces and a loader-routed Neo4j driver surface. The first full run passes 287/287 tests and reports src/index.ts at L98.61% / B89.12% / F98.86%; scripts remain 100%. Export widenings parseNeo4jMs and workspaceFromPmRoot are justified because their return branches are not observably distinguishable through the command surface (invalid timeout parsing only changes driver config; custom-root workspace derivation requires direct path cases), and both retain production behavior. toPlain/toNumber/neo4jFriendlyError were covered through the actual query/status/neighbors/sync handlers with a loader-routed driver and were not widened.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Second coverage milestone: exercised tracker-root discovery (typed and generic errors), unreadable tracker SDK failures, unexpected export/sync/impact error wrapping via real registered handlers, malformed/externally-targeted dependency records, case-insensitive ambiguity and capped id suggestions, and direct Neo4j-friendly default URI/error branches. Targeted tests pass; source exports now include only the documented helpers needed for otherwise unreachable direct branch assertions (parseNeo4jMs, workspaceFromPmRoot, neo4jFriendlyError, resolveItemIdOrThrow, runPmGraph).

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Dead-code removal: removed the explain-command null-report branch (src/index.ts) because resolveItemIdOrThrow selects from itemNodeIds(graph), while explainItem's only null path is itemNodeMap(graph) using the identical PmItem label predicate on the same graph snapshot. The invariant is enforced by itemNodeIds/itemNodeMap themselves; the public explainItem helper remains nullable for unresolved direct callers.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Third coverage milestone: added behavioral coverage for legacy dependency key normalization, malformed/duplicate relationships, external nodes and facet edges, sparse legacy metadata fallbacks, parser edge cases, non-string filter properties, capped suggestions, and JSON/Mermaid renderer fallbacks. The small pure helpers are exported with existing API documentation solely so these malformed-input branches can be exercised without SDK/API doubles.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Fourth coverage milestone: exercised offline analytics on dangling/duplicate/cyclic/componented graphs, longest-chain ties, topo cycles, connector calculations, sparse item titles/status/depths, and all registered handlers with omitted optional args. Removed three unreachable explain helper fallbacks: structural edges are already restricted to the item map, and dependencyDepths initializes every resolved item.
